screenshotSelection.note: These are selected screenshots. The exact raw reports preserve names of additional screenshots retained in their original CI artifacts.

visualAssessment.claim: Real-time surface and model detail improvement; 100% photorealism has not been achieved.
observedImprovements: The matched garden view shows photographic lawn variation, rounded cushions and open woven furniture frames.
The interior shows visible floorboard grain and knots, timber material detail and contact shading.
The pool reflects surrounding scene content, and the visible garage car has a curved reflective body.
remainingLimits: Close vegetation shows repeated foliage cards, branch pieces and simplified plant forms.
Surrounding buildings remain simplified context geometry.
Exterior architectural surfaces and comparatively even lighting retain a model-like appearance.
The swimming-eye pool view shows broad horizontal reflection bands and simplified water response.
visualAssessment.materialScope: Photographic maps are representative finishes, not photographs or verified specifications of installed materials.
visualAssessment.vehicleEvidence: The Modern garage screenshot visibly shows one car. Scene counters and functional/refinements checks verify the two-car configuration; that screenshot alone does not demonstrate both cars.
